# Feed Flow!: Baby Feeding Tracker for iPhone

> A baby feeding tracker with a countdown on every bottle, a breastfeeding and pumping log, and a report for the pediatrician.

Feed Flow! is an iPhone app, available now on the App Store (https://apps.apple.com/app/id6782075454). Start a formula bottle and a one-hour countdown starts with it. The time left shows on the lock screen too. The app also logs breastfeeding, pumping, solids and water, shows a likely time for the next feed, and makes a PDF report to share with a pediatrician. Your baby's data stays in your own iCloud. Feed Flow! runs no server that holds it.

## What it does

- **Bottle countdown:** a formula bottle gets a one-hour countdown by default (started, time left, ends). You can change the hour for each kind of feed. The countdown also shows on the lock screen, with the time left and how much is left in the bottle. When time is up, the app asks how much the baby took. The countdown is free.
- **Next feed:** after about four days of feeds, the app learns the baby's rhythm and shows a likely time for the next feed on Home. It is a guide, not a promise. The full day-ahead forecast is Premium.
- **Today at a glance:** Home shows the last feed, today's total and what is next. Bottles, breastfeeding, pumping, solids and water go in the same log, in a few taps.
- **One log for the family:** a partner, a grandparent or a sitter can log to the same baby on their own phone, through iCloud. Up to five people, free. The activity feed that shows who fed and when is Premium.
- **Report for the pediatrician:** a PDF made from the parent's own log, with the feeds, the amounts and the weekly trend. Premium.
- **Vitamin D:** log the drops and see them counted with the vitamin D listed on the formula's label.
- **Formula finder:** compare formulas side by side, using the numbers printed on each label.

## Pricing

Free to download. Logging is free forever, along with the bottle countdown, the next feed's time on Home and caregiver sharing. Premium adds the day-ahead forecast, the activity feed, the vitamin D meter, the report and the full history. Plans are monthly, annual (with a 14-day free trial), or a one-time Lifetime purchase. Prices are set per region by Apple and shown in the App Store.

## Common questions

**Is the app free?**
Yes. Logging is free forever, with the bottle countdown. Premium adds the forecast, the activity feed, the vitamin D meter, the report and the full history.

**Can I track breastfeeding and formula in the same app?**
Yes. Formula, breastfeeding, pumping, solids and water go in one log.

**Can caregivers share one log?**
Yes. Invite up to five people from the Family screen. They log on their own phones, through iCloud. A feed can take a moment to show up on the other phone.

**Is my data private?**
Yes. It lives on the phone and in the parent's own iCloud. There are no ads and no tracking. Robin Andersson, who makes the app, cannot see it.

**Is it medical advice?**
No. Feed Flow! is not a medical device. Before you act on a number, check it against the label, the pack or your health nurse: this is a record, not medical advice.

## Ambassador / affiliate program

Feed Flow! runs a two-tier ambassador program for parent bloggers, parenting influencers, midwife accounts, and family content creators. Ambassadors earn 25% commission on every direct sale they drive and 5% override on sales generated by ambassadors they recruit. Free to join, no minimum audience. Apply at https://tryfeedflow.app/affiliate.html
